title: Shiv Sena UBT leader Aaditya Thackeray writes to CM Fadnavis over 935 Pagdi buildings
description: Pagdi buildings stand for an old tenanted building where occupiers paid a large one-time amount to the landlord and then paid a low monthly rent, giving tenant semi-ownership rights, legalised under the Maharashtra Rent Control Act of 1999 and has been in effect since 2000
